list.empty: No examples yet. Open a turn in Trajectories and press “Add to examples”, or create one by hand.
list.error: The example library could not be loaded.

coverage.title: Entry × scene counts
coverage.hint: Active examples only; a cell needs {{target}} for the owner's example card to show a full row

form.collectDescription: These fields came from the session; add the shop type, tags, rating and notes, then save.
form.newDescription: Outputs and inputs take existing asset ids; paste the review card or prompt into “Recipe”.
form.title: Title
form.tagsHint: Comma separated, up to 12, e.g. visit, evening, ¥30 per head
form.ratingHint: 5 = approved on the spot, a template; 3 = structure usable, copy ordinary; 1 = counter-example only
form.notesHint: What is good about it and what the AI should learn (shown to the AI as written)
form.recipe: Recipe (review card / prompt as it was)
form.noAssets: No output came back. Enter asset ids by hand, or pick another output on the trajectory page.
form.loadFailed: The session could not be read.
form.needOutput: At least one output is required
form.tooManyAssets: {{kind}}: at most {{max}}, there are {{count}}. Remove the extras to save
form.recipeTooLong: The recipe can be {{max}} characters at most, it has {{count}}. Trim it to save

errors.EXAMPLE_INVALID: Classification or asset id is wrong: {{message}}
errors.HTTP_422: Something is over a limit or in the wrong format. Check it and save again

taxonomy.title: Classification
taxonomy.description: Examples are filed by scene (per entry) and by industry and shop type. Changes here apply to the filters, the example form and the example card's matching.
taxonomy.scenesHint: Built-in scenes are the App's opening choices: rename them, but they stay. Scenes you add file examples, and the AI uses one when the owner's purpose fits it.
taxonomy.industriesHint: Keywords guess a shop type from the shop's name and headline; separate them with commas. Built-in industries match what owners choose: rename them, but they stay.
taxonomy.builtin: Built in: the App and owner profiles use it, so it can only be renamed
taxonomy.generic: Every industry keeps one generic shop type

problem.duplicate: Two in one group share a name

errors.TAXONOMY_IN_USE: Examples still use these. Move them to another class first: {{message}}
errors.HTTP_422: A name or keyword is over a limit. Check it and save again

card.title: Reference card
card.afterSave: After saving, the finished piece is read once (the picture itself, or frames and speech of the clip) with the recipe and written up as a reference card, in a minute or two. Open the example again to see and edit it.
card.fullHint: Structure, rhythm, style and copy patterns only; no shop name, dish or price. A text edited by hand is never overwritten.

state.none: Not read yet; starts after saving
state.reading: Reading the piece, a minute or two…
